result.description:
KGI Logistics Pty Ltd

Heavy Truck Drivers (ANZSCO: 733111)

Full-time/Permanent

$80,000 - $90,000 (salary will be considered commensurate to qualifications and experience)

The company wishes to employ heavy truck drivers to work with our mining and Long Line Haul (East-West and North-West) clients

Duties and Responsibilities:

*Drive truck with capacity of more than 3 tons to transport and deliver cargo or materials.
*Work in remote locations and drive long distances.
*Deliver goods via heavy haulage trucks, sometimes over interstate routes or spanning several states.
*Conduct daily pre- and post-trip inspections of vehicles to maintain working operations, record any defects they find.
*Load and unload cargo with multiple drops.
*Secure proof of deliveries and return relevant paperwork to office timely.
*Ensure load restraint is performed as per heavy vehicle load restraint guide. 
*Maintain radio or telephone contact with base or supervisor to receive instructions or be dispatched to new location.
*Be efficient in completing the necessary delivery paperwork including run sheets and work diaries.
*Be able to take orders for new deliveries. 
*Maintain truck log according to State and Federal regulations.
*Report to a dispatcher any incidents encountered on the road.
*Follow accident procedures if an accident occurs.
*Fill up on fuel, clean truck, and wash windows on completion of each trip.
*Keep record of materials and products transported.
*Keep a log of activities.
*Keep truck, and associated equipment, clean and in good working order.
*Plan routes using maps or satellite tracking.

Qualifications and Experience:
*AQF certificate II or III
*Valid Australian MC truck licence
*Minimum of 1 year’s recent heavy/multi-combination driving experience
*Able to work with, maintain and carry out general repairs and maintenance on pumps, metres and related equipment
*Demonstrate sound geographic knowledge Australia-wide
*Be highly reliable with a first-class approach to safety and customer service with good communication skills
*Fatigue Management Certificate
*Able to pass a drug and alcohol and pre-employment medical
*MSIC Card
*Load restraint certificate
*Require DG Licence or willing to obtain
*Dogs and chain experience
*Side and End Tipper experience 
*BFM certificate is required or willing to obtain
*Forklift ticket is required or willing to obtain 


Maintenance Planner (ANZSCO: 312911 – Maintenance Planner)

Full time/Permanent

$80,000 - $ 90,000 (salary will be considered commensurate to qualifications and experience)

Duties and Responsibilities:

*Compile and maintain an online system of all vehicles and related equipment (e.g. lifting equipment, cranes for lifting and loading onto trailers, hand-held equipment, manual transport equipment, ramps, straps, winches, chains and pulleys, etc) within the business
*Prepare preventive maintenance plans (the “plans”) that are aligned with the organization’s maintenance goals
*Generate work orders and create maintenance schedules to ensure the availability of resources to carry out relevant maintenance as per the plans
*Maintain sufficient inventory of parts needed to perform any planned and/or unplanned maintenance
*Inspect all facilities and equipment on a regular basis to prioritize needed maintenance before it becomes a problem
*Estimate costs of labour and parts
*Budget for and schedule any maintenance that must be performed on a regular basis and in cases of emergencies
*Serve as a liaison between maintenance personnel and vehicle operatives
*Maintain records and files essential to maintenance management
*Source, negotiate and develop service agreements with external maintenance providers
*Coordinate between maintenance providers, vehicle operatives and stakeholders involved in the provision of maintenance works
*Maintain a safe, efficient work environment for maintenance personnel, contractors and employees

Relevant Qualification/Experience
*Relevant AQF associate degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma or 3 years of relevant experience may replace the need to have a qualification
*Applicants with qualification will require a minimum of 1 years of relevant experience


Transport Manager (ANZSCO 149413 – Transport Company Manager)

Full time/Permanent

$80,000 - $ 90,000 (salary will be considered commensurate to qualifications and experience)

Duties and Responsibilities:

*Organise the purchase/lease of vehicles, parts, and fuel.
*Organise inspection and servicing of vehicles.
*Record and report maintenance and repair needs for vehicles and related equipment.
*Keep organized records of vehicles, service/repair schedules and authorise payments for completed orders.
*Ensure regular road-worthy and safety audits on vehicles and equipment.
*Monitor and report on transport and transportation costs and make necessary changes to reduce costs – with a view to improve the business’s bottom line.
*Organize training sessions for employees (e.g., proper licensing/permits; training in driving vehicles of various types & sizes; proper use of lifting/moving devices associated with vehicles)
*Stay up to date with safety regulations and train staff to adhere to them when handling or driving vehicles. 
*Resolve transport and transportation issues in line with business and customers’ need e.g., arranging appropriate type of vehicles based on the type and quantity of the consignments.
*Lead and coordinate the activities associated with the loading and unloading of consignments.

Relevant Qualification/Experience

*Relevant AQF associate degree, Advanced Diploma or Diploma or 3 years of relevant experience may replace the need to have a qualification
*Applicants with qualification will require a minimum of 1 years of relevant experience

result.description:
Multiple Positions – Mechanical (Small, Auto, Light and Heavy)

Offshore Staff Assist 
All States and Territory’s in Australia
Local and FIFO positions available 
Mechanical / Electrical (Trades & Services)
Full time
$70,000 – $200,000 per annum

Vacancy Listing Dates 09/07/2026 to 10/08/2026

Explore a world of career opportunities with us across every state of Australia, including New South Wales, Victoria, Queensland, Western Australia, South Australia, Tasmania, the Australian Capital Territory, and the Northern Territory. Join our dynamic team today and start your journey in the state that feels like home.

Offshore Staff Assist is currently hiring for a broad range of positions across various sectors on behalf of our client. We recognize your enthusiasm for becoming a part of our team and are keen to support your professional development. Our focus on excellence and innovation is at the core of our business, offering a solid foundation for your skills to develop and succeed. 
We are not just offering jobs, but long-term career opportunities that promise growth and advancement within the company we service. If you're looking for a role where your contributions are valued and your professional growth is a priority, please join us to build a future where your career aspirations align with our commitment to progress and hard work.
We're currently looking for qualified: 
•	Motor Mechanic (General)
•	Auto Electrician 
•	Diesel Motor Mechanic
•	Small Engine Mechanic (Including Outboard)
•	Upholsterer (Outboard/Marine, Vehicle and Custom)
•	Motorcycle Mechanic 
•	Fitter General (Including Heavy)

To be considered for the below roles, you must have a minimum 3 years’ experience.

Motor Mechanic (General)
We are seeking a skilled Motor Vehicle Mechanic to join our team. The ideal candidate will be experienced in diagnosing and repairing various makes and models of cars, utilizing advanced diagnostic tools to troubleshoot issues, and performing routine maintenance and repairs. A strong understanding of automotive systems and a commitment to delivering high-quality workmanship are essential.
Auto Electrician
Join our team as an Auto Electrician, where you will be responsible for installing, maintaining, and repairing electrical wiring and electronic components in motor vehicles. The ideal candidate should have expertise in reading technical diagrams and manuals, as well as a solid foundation in handling various electrical systems within the automotive industry.
Diesel Motor Mechanic
We are looking for a Diesel Motor Mechanic to manage the maintenance and repair of diesel engines. The role involves inspecting engine components, diagnosing issues for efficient resolution, and performing preventive maintenance to ensure the longevity and reliability of diesel-powered vehicles. Knowledge of modern diagnostic tools and techniques for diesel engines is required.
Small Engine Mechanic (Including Outboard)
Our team requires a Small Engine Mechanic skilled in repairing and maintaining engines used in power equipment such as lawn mowers, chain saws, and snow blowers. Candidates should possess detailed knowledge of small engine operations and the ability to troubleshoot fuel, mechanical, and electrical systems effectively.
Outboard mechanics must test and repair boat engines and related, electrical systems, navigational equipment, hulls, propellers. Including steering and air conditioning where required.
Upholsterer (Outboard/Marine, Vehicle and Custom)
We seek an upholsterer with experience working on outboard, vehicles including light and heavy rigid. Experience in seat, fit out repair. Fixing trim, making repairs to wooden frames and items, removal of defective equipment and materials. Experience on custom made manifolds, wrappings and bespoke material and equipment. Cost analysis and repair estimation of items, fabric and materials required.
Motorcycle Mechanic
We are in search of a Motorcycle Mechanic to handle diagnostics, repairs, and servicing of motorcycles and similar vehicles. This role requires a deep understanding of motorcycle mechanics, including engine components, suspension, and electrical systems. The ideal candidate should demonstrate a passion for motorcycles and a drive to deliver excellent service.
Fitter General (Including Heavy)
A Fitter position is available for professional skill in maintaining and repairing automated systems, plant and also heavy-duty machinery and equipment. Responsibilities include performing major repair work, conducting inspections to ensure compliance with safety regulations, and troubleshooting hydraulic and pneumatic systems. Experience with construction, mining, or agricultural machinery is highly advantageous.
